publicWording: I create operating structure for complex public-facing teams.

publicWording: Jamie helps teams clarify requirements, map workflows, maintain decision records, coordinate launch support, prepare onboarding materials, and leave behind durable handoffs.
plainLanguageWording: Jamie makes complicated work easier to continue.
